name: Reviewell Autonomous AEO & Citation Intelligence Agent
architectureSummary: A 14-node, 10-stage programmable AEO Marketing Engineering agent spanning all 5 Profound node categories (Data, Research, LLM, Logic, Integration). Implements the full Detection -> Analysis -> Delivery -> Baseline Advancement loop using dual persistent Knowledge Bases (separating Reviewell Internal Baselines from Competitor Citation Baselines), Profound Data nodes (Visibility Score, Citation Share, Citation Pages) filtered to the Big Four AI engines (ChatGPT, AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini) plus Perplexity, Boolean structured outputs driving conditional notification gates, and upstream-variable-wired prompts.

profoundData.provider: Profound Data Nodes & REST API (https://api.tryprofound.com / https://mcp.tryprofound.com/mcp)

nodes.name: Profound Visibility & Topic Rank Data Node
nodes.description: Pulls Profound Visibility Score, Topic Ranks, and Prompt-level executions filtered intentionally to ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Gemini, and Perplexity over the last 7 days.

nodes.name: Profound Citation Share & Top Citation Pages Node
nodes.description: Pulls Profound Citation Share and Top Citation Pages (URL, source category, Mentioned vs Not Mentioned, citation count, and citation share delta).

nodes.name: Knowledge Base Reader (Internal & Competitor Baselines)
nodes.description: Reads 'reviewell_internal_visibility_baseline.json' and 'competitor_citation_supply_chain_baseline.json' from the persistent Knowledge Base at the start of each run so downstream LLM nodes can compute longitudinal deltas.

nodes.name: Detection LLM (Structured Boolean & Delta Evaluator)
nodes.description: Compares Current_Profound_Visibility and Current_Profound_Citations against Reviewell_Internal_Baseline and Competitor_Citation_Baseline. Emits a programmable Boolean 'significant_change_detected' to drive conditional branching.
nodes.prompt: You are the Detection Marketing Engineer for Reviewell BV. Compare {{Current_Profound_Visibility}} and {{Current_Profound_Citations}} against the stored Knowledge Base snapshots {{Reviewell_Internal_Baseline}} and {{Competitor_Citation_Baseline}}. Identify whether any topic rank shifted by >= 1 position or Citation Share shifted by >= 3.5% across a sample size >= 15 prompts. Set Boolean 'significant_change_detected' to true ONLY if a meaningful movement or high-share 'Not Mentioned' citation gap exists; otherwise set it to false so we never spam stakeholders.

nodes.name: Conditional Gate: Significant Change Detected?
nodes.description: Branches strictly on the Boolean structured output 'Detection_Evaluation.significant_change_detected'. If false, halts delivery and logs a silent heartbeat.

nodes.name: Web Page Scrape: Top Cited Competitor Pages
nodes.description: Scrapes the exact URLs in {{Detection_Evaluation.detected_citation_gap_urls}} (e.g., support.google.com, removify.com, erase.com) to inspect their Billboard, H2 answer blocks, comparison tables, and JSON-LD schema.

nodes.name: Web Page Scrape & Technical Audit: Owned Reviewell Page
nodes.description: Scrapes Reviewell's corresponding target page and /llms.txt to evaluate the Three Gates (Fetchable, Chosen, Extractable).

nodes.name: Three Gates & SAGE Diagnostic Synthesizer LLM
nodes.description: Connects the dots across {{Detection_Evaluation.delta_summary}}, {{Current_Competitor_Page_Structure}}, and {{Current_Reviewell_Page_Structure}} to diagnose which Gate (Fetchable, Chosen, Extractable) is failing and whether the fix is reproducible.
nodes.prompt: Connect the dots between the Profound metric shift in {{Detection_Evaluation.delta_summary}}, the winning competitor structure in {{Current_Competitor_Page_Structure}}, and Reviewell's current page structure in {{Current_Reviewell_Page_Structure}}. Determine which of the Three Gates (Fetchable, Chosen, Extractable) explains why the competitor page won the citation, verify that our evidence confidence is >= 0.82 without making any unverified review-removal guarantees, and set Boolean 'actionable_fix_verified' accordingly.

nodes.name: Conditional Gate: Actionable Fix Verified?
nodes.description: Branches on the Boolean field 'Three_Gates_Diagnosis.actionable_fix_verified' so only verified, high-confidence diagnoses proceed to patch generation and stakeholder notification.

nodes.name: AEO Patch & Billboard Generator LLM
nodes.description: Uses {{Three_Gates_Diagnosis.root_cause_diagnosis}} and {{Current_Reviewell_Page_Structure}} to generate the exact replacement Billboard, structured Policy-to-Evidence Answer Block, FAQPage JSON-LD, and /llms-full.txt update.
nodes.prompt: Using the root-cause diagnosis in {{Three_Gates_Diagnosis.root_cause_diagnosis}} (Failing Gate: {{Three_Gates_Diagnosis.failing_gate}}, SAGE Phase: {{Three_Gates_Diagnosis.sage_phase}}) and the existing page content in {{Current_Reviewell_Page_Structure}}, generate a ready-to-ship AEO upgrade: (1) an updated 150-word Billboard addressing the compound job, (2) a machine-extractable HTML/Markdown comparison table, and (3) a strict Schema.org FAQPage JSON-LD snippet.

nodes.name: Conditional Approval Gate (Human-in-the-Loop)
nodes.description: Gates production publishing until the marketing engineer approves the generated patch bundle.

nodes.name: Slack / Email Executive Digest Delivery Node
nodes.description: Delivers the gated Diagnosis Report and Approved_AEO_Patch_Bundle to the Reviewell growth channel ONLY when both conditional gates passed.

nodes.name: GitHub PR & CMS Patch Publisher Node
nodes.description: Commits Approved_AEO_Patch_Bundle (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, FAQPage JSON-LD) to the Reviewell repository.

nodes.name: Knowledge Base Writer (Baseline Advancement Overwrite)
nodes.description: Overwrites 'reviewell_internal_visibility_baseline.json' with {{Current_Profound_Visibility}} and 'competitor_citation_supply_chain_baseline.json' with {{Current_Profound_Citations}} so the next run compares against the freshly advanced baseline rather than stale data.
